description: AI customer-conversation and support platform spanning website chat, email, WhatsApp, SMS, lead capture, automation, human handoff, team inboxes, and agentic actions.

evidence.finding: Boei lets teams configure AI actions, channels, training sources, and when conversations hand off to human agents, with human operators able to take over from the shared inbox.
Boei states customers can cancel subscriptions at any time, and its product materials describe export or deletion of user data on request.
Boei publishes detailed pricing, security, subprocessors, data-processing terms, and how its website crawler and AI channels operate.
Boei documents human handoff for conversations the AI cannot answer, with agents notified and able to take over directly from the shared inbox.
Boei offers low-cost flat plans, a 7-day no-card trial, included AI credits, and startup-focused workflows intended to reduce support and lead-handling workload.
Boei states data subjects can exercise access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection rights, and provides a DPA for business customers.
Boei supports API access, webhooks, multiple channels, data export/delete rights, and cancellation without long-term contracts, reducing dependency on a single closed workflow.
Boei publishes monthly and annual prices, included AI credits, no-card trials, no long-term contracts, and clearly stated plan limits.
Boei provides team inboxes and multiple human-agent seats so teams can collaborate around AI-assisted customer conversations and handoffs.
Boei explicitly supports escalation to human agents when AI cannot answer and positions its AI as handling repetitive support while people handle important conversations.
Boei offers a 7-day free trial without a credit card, low-entry plans, 95+ languages, and support across common website platforms and messaging channels.

limitations: This preliminary audit uses public Boei primary-source documentation and has not been reviewed by Boei.
Published product documentation is evidence of documented controls and policies, not proof of real-world outcomes for every deployment.
Humanity Score is a product-impact rating, not a regulatory, legal, safety, compliance, or government certification.
correction_policy: Source-backed factual corrections are welcome. Corrections change the audit only when the underlying evidence changes; payment cannot buy a higher score.
